exposure: knowledge of danger signs and complications
outcome: male partner involvement in postnatal care service utilization
cohort: The study included 629 male partners whose spouses had recently given birth in Wolaita Sodo, southern Ethiopia.
finding: The study found that 32.95% of male partners were involved in postnatal care service utilization, with higher maternal education, good knowledge of PNC services and danger signs, a favorable attitude, closer distance to care, and cesarean delivery significantly associated with higher involvement.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with a higher likelihood of male partner involvement in postnatal care services.
